description: This PHP source file defines an abstract base test case class for testing API endpoints within the OrangeHRM system. It provides utility methods to create request objects, mock API endpoints, and assert various exception scenarios for endpoint testing. The class uses traits and extends PHPUnit's testing framework to facilitate testing of the API layer.

classes.name: EndpointTestCase
classes.description: An abstract base class providing common utilities for testing API endpoints, including request creation, mock building, and exception assertions.

methods.name: getRequest
methods.description: Creates a new Request object wrapping a HttpRequest with specified query, request data, and attributes.

methods.name: getApiEndpointMockBuilder
methods.description: Creates and returns a PHPUnit MockBuilder for a specified API class, initialized with a mock request built from request parameters.

methods.name: expectNotImplementedException
methods.description: Asserts that the code under test throws a NotImplementedException.

methods.name: expectRecordNotFoundException
methods.description: Asserts that the code under test throws a RecordNotFoundException.

methods.name: expectBadRequestException
methods.description: Asserts that the code under test throws a BadRequestException.

methods.name: expectInvalidParamException
methods.description: Asserts that the code under test throws an InvalidParamException.

methods.name: expectForbiddenException
methods.description: Asserts that the code under test throws a ForbiddenException.

methods.name: assertInvalidParamException
methods.description: Executes a validation closure and asserts it throws an InvalidParamException with specified invalid keys.
